name: Luda Solovyova Will be the Last Person on Earth
source:
Luda Solovyova's never been satisfied with life, and it only seems to be getting worse as of late. Follow her as one afternoon, a couple of people, and a few choice decisions completely change her entire life.

[From [url=https://albatr0ss-s0up.itch.io/luda-solovyova]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卢达·索洛维约娃（Luda Solovyova）对生活从来都不满意，而且最近似乎只会变得更糟。跟随她，一个下午，几个人，几个选择彻底改变了她的一生。

[来自[url=https://albatr0ss-s0up.itch.io/luda-solovyova]itch.io[/url]]
